maddeler.e:
أستمرئ (form X)
# أَسْتَمْرِئُ (ʔastamriʔu) /ʔas.tam.ri.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمْرَأَ (istamraʔa)
# أَسْتَمْرِئَ (ʔastamriʔa) /ʔas.tam.ri.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَمْرَأَ (istamraʔa)
# أَسْتَمْرِئْ (ʔastamriʔ) /ʔas.tam.riʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَمْرَأَ (istamraʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
